headline: Three more cabinets take the wheel: Tetris, Excitebike and Marble Madness now drive themselves
lede: WATCH batch 9 seats each game's own proven autopilot into the live play tick — the planner that already runs the attract demo and already gets graded by its own harness — so pressing Y mid-run hands the cabinet to the brain that wins it, and any key or touch takes it straight back.

notes.text: WATCH rollout reached 44 titles: batch 9 was the planner-in-the-box family — Tetris re-plans at every piece lock, Excitebike re-decides by rolling the real sim every tick, Marble Madness steers the same BFS arcs that generated its attract script.

The proof that it is really thinking: Tetris watches a well where only a SLIDE can finish the row (bag luck can clear rows eventually, luck never slides a piece), Excitebike watches distance climb from a bike nobody is touching, Marble Madness watches the marble leave a shelf it never leaves on its own.

The phone-layout contract bit the new seats: the pill's geometry window started inside the attract block, so its 24% bottom anchor read as 'under the thumb zone'. Fix is the shape the passing titles already use — attract WATCH as its own guarded sibling, pill ahead of the attract chrome.

Harness noise worth knowing: the warden kicked slot b twice in one tick, so two sessions resumed the same half-built branch into the same worktree and port, killing each other's dev server until one died. Filed as #1782 with a liveness fix; verification moved to an isolated worktree on a free port.

look.text: TETRIS — press Y on any live well and the planner slides the I home
MARBLE MADNESS — Y seats the autopilot that ran all six races
